extracted.name: Cricket Protein Powder Pancakes
extracted.description: By replacing a portion of regular flour with cricket protein powder, this recipe delivers a sustainable energy boost to power your morning.
ingredient_lines: Icing sugar and fresh berries, or syrup on top (optional)
instruction_lines: Mix dry ingredients: Whisk the flour, cricket powder, baking powder, salt, and brown sugar together in a large bowl.
Form a well: Create a small valley in the center of your dry mixture.
Add wet ingredients: Pour in the milk, half-egg, and melted butter. Stir until you get a smooth batter.
Heat the pan: Set a griddle or frying pan to medium-high heat. Lightly coat it with oil or butter.
Cook: Pour 1/4 cup scoops of batter onto the hot surface. Flip once bubbles form and the bottom turns light brown. Cook until both sides achieve a golden-brown finish.
Serve: Top immediately with your choice of berries, powdered sugar, or syrup
